name: ogn-3d-viewer-spots
title: Gliding spots around the world
description: A curated seed list of notable soaring sites, keyed by the code used to load them from the OGN FlightBook (usually but not always an ICAO code). Meant to help newcomers 'visit' famous gliding places in the 3D viewer.

fields.name: code
fields.title: Airfield code
fields.description: Identifier used to load flights from the OGN FlightBook (ICAO where available, otherwise a national/FAA identifier).

fields.name: flightbook_checked
fields.title: Last FlightBook check
fields.description: Date the code was last verified on the OGN FlightBook (see scripts/check-spots.ts); empty means not found there.
